facts.business: Hindustan Appliances Limited is a listed company with minimal operations, reporting a loss for FY2025-26 and only 4 permanent employees.
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with Related Parties entered in Financial Year 2025-26, were in ordinary course of business and at arm's length basis and in accordance with the provisions of the Act and the Rules made thereunder, the Listing Regulations and the Company's Policy on Related Party Transactions and that the provisions of Section 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 are not attracted. Thus disclosure in Form AOC-2 is not required. There are no related party transactions that may have potential conflict with the interest of the Company at large.
